blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: . Integrating heterogeneous datasets within data lakes is a critical challenge, particularly for semantically related tables that lack the explicit attributes needed to be joined. We study Discovery-Driven Integration , where the relevant sources and their missing relational structure must be discovered before integration. In this setting, unstructured text provides the evidence that connects otherwise disjoint tables. The fundamental challenge is to discover the relationships at a fine-grained level that connect individual rows from different tables through specific sentences. We formalize this task as Text-Mediated Join Path Discovery and propose a horizontal bidirectional cross-attention architecture called LOKI ( L atent-space O ptimization for K nowledge I ntegration) 1 1 1 Code & Artifacts : https://github.com/dtim-upc/LOKI that learns contextualized representations of table rows and sentences. Through a global table-text contrastive objective, fine-grained row-sentence associations emerge without explicit local supervision. Existing multi-modal discovery methods largely retrieve coarse-grained column-text associations, whereas integration systems assume supplied row-text links, schemas, or queries. LOKI instead transforms these implicit associations into explicit, interpretable join paths, organizes them into relation-consistent groups, and materializes them as typed integrated tables with sentence-level provenance. Comprehensive evaluations on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that LOKI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-modal data discovery approaches, and materializes typed integrated tables with 0.982 macro typed-pair precision while being up to 40 times cheaper in LLM API cost than direct prompting.

blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Data lakes serve as centralized repositories consolidating large volumes of heterogeneous data, often containing thousands of datasets with structured tables and large collections of unstructured text documents. Information embedded in text contains valuable insights that remain inaccessible unless extracted and integrated with structured data: in a hospital data lake, for example, discharge summaries may link patient records to medication treatments. Extracting and integrating such information makes it available for analysis.
blocks.zh: 数据湖是集中式储存库,汇集了大量不同数据,往往包含有结构化表格和大量非结构化文本文件的数千个数据集。 文本中包含的信息含有宝贵的洞察力,除非提取出来并与结构化数据相融合,否则仍然无法获取:例如,在医院数据湖中,出院摘要可能将患者记录与药物治疗联系起来。 提取和综合这类信息可以进行分析。

blocks.en: Recently, several methods have been proposed for text-table querying , allowing users to retrieve information from both modalities, e.g., ( Urban and Binnig, 2024 ; Jo and Trummer, 2024 ; Rahman et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . However, these methods share a key limitation: they assume that the integration between the two modalities is already known. In particular, they require knowledge of (1) the row-text links , i.e., which part of the text is associated to each table row, and (2) the text schema , i.e., what information is contained in this part of the text. Essentially, they perform query-time extraction over a predefined text-table integration. For example, ELEET ( Urban and Binnig, 2024 ) processes queries that specify a latent attribute to be extracted from text for each table row, while ThalamusDB ( Jo and Trummer, 2024 ) processes queries containing a Boolean predicate expressed in natural language over a text document. The latent attribute in the former and the predicate in the latter specify text schema, while the association between text and table rows is assumed to be known.
blocks.zh: 最近,有人提出了几种文本表查询方法,允许用户从两种模式中检索信息,例如(Urban and Binnig, 2024;Jo and Trummer, 2024;Rahman等人, 2024;Wang等人, 2025)。 然而,这些方法有一个关键的限制:它们假定两种方式之间的结合已经众所周知。 尤其是,它们要求了解(1)行-文本链接,即文本的哪一部分与每个表格行相关;(2)文本计划,即文本的这一部分包含哪些信息。 基本上,它们通过预先定义的文本表集成进行查询时间提取. 例如,ELEET(Urban and Binnig, 2024)处理询问,这些询问指定了每个表格行要从文本中提取的潜在属性,而ThalamusDB(Jo and Trummer, 2024)处理询问,其中包含一个以自然语言在文本文档上表达的布尔上游. 前者的潜在属性和后者的上位属性指定了文本计划,而文本和表格行之间的关联则被假定为已知.

blocks.en: To fully extract value from data lakes, we must remove these two assumptions and enable text-table integration , where neither row-text associations nor text schemas are known beforehand. Existing multi-modal discovery and retrieval techniques ( Fernandez et al., 2018b ; Fernandez and Madden, 2019 ; Anadiotis et al., 2022 ; Eltabakh et al., 2023 ) identify only coarse-grained associations between columns (or tables) and text, missing fine-grained row-text links. This is insufficient for integration in two ways. It can collapse semantically distinct relationships: a discharge summary may state that a patient was prescribed aspirin, had an adverse reaction, and later discontinued it (three relationships a coarse-grained association cannot distinguish). It can also introduce spurious ones (e.g., linking a patient to every medication merely discussed rather than prescribed).
blocks.zh: 为了从数据湖中充分取出价值,我们必须去掉这两个假设,并实现文本表的整合,因为在此之前既不知道行文本关联,也不知道文本计划。 现有的多式发现和取回技术(Fernandez等,2018b;Fernandez和Madden等,2019;Anadiotis等,2022;Eltabakh等,2023)只识别出栏(或表)和正文之间粗糙相接,缺失细纹行-正文链接. 这不足以在两个方面实现一体化。 它可以崩溃成形的区别关系:出院摘要可以说明患者是处方阿司匹林,有不良反应,后来中止了它(三种关系是粗糙的结合无法区分的). 也可以引入虚假的药物(例如,将病人与仅讨论过而不是开处方的每一种药物联系起来)。

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, no existing method automatically discovers both the fine-grained row-text associations and the schemas needed to integrate text with existing tables. In this work, we present LOKI, a system that discovers such associations, starting from fine-grained row-text links : two links with overlapping text spans and rows from different tables indicate that the text expresses a relationship between them. We call the resulting sequence of a table row, a supporting text span, and another table row a text-mediated join path . LOKI collects the join paths for each pair of tables, examining their supporting text to determine whether they express one relationship or several, each defining a text schema .
blocks.zh: 就我们所知,没有一种现有方法能够自动发现精细的行文字联系和将文本与现有表格相融合所需的计划。 在这项工作中,我们介绍LOKI,这是一个发现这种关联的系统,从精细的行-行-行链接开始:两个与文本跨度相重叠的链接和不同表格的行表示文本表达了它们之间的关系. 我们称由此产生的表格行顺序、支持文本跨度和另一个表格行为以文本为媒介的连接路径。 LOKI 收集每对表格的连接路径, 检查它们的辅助文本, 以确定它们是表达一种关系还是几种关系, 每一种定义一个文本计划 。

blocks.en: Overview of LOKI . At the heart of LOKI is a cross-modal encoder that takes a table and a text document as input and produces embeddings for each table row and document sentence. The encoder combines a frozen text encoder with a trainable bidirectional attention mechanism that contextualizes each row embedding with information from the document and each sentence embedding with information from the table: rows attend to sentences in the forward direction, and sentences attend to rows in the reverse. LOKI uses the resulting contextualized embeddings to compute a row-sentence pair-score matrix that captures fine-grained associations between rows and sentences. LOKI does not require costly row-sentence annotations for training. Instead, it relies on a small number of potentially noisy coarse table-document annotations, which can be obtained from weak signals such as syntactic or embedding-based similarity, or weak-supervision techniques ( Ratner et al., 2016 ) , as done in ( Yin et al., 2020 ; Eltabakh et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: LOKI概览. LOKI的核心是一个跨模式编码器,它取一个表格和一个文本文档作为输入并生成每个表格行和文档句子的嵌入. 编码器结合了被冻结的文本编码器和一个可被训练的双向注意机制,将每行嵌入从文档中的信息与从表格中嵌入到每个句子的背景化:行会处理向前方向的句子,而句子会处理倒行. LOKI 使用由此而来的背景化嵌入来计算出一个行刑对分矩阵,该矩阵可以捕捉行和句子之间的细纹相通. LOKI培训不需要昂贵的排行判决说明。 相反,它依赖于少量可能吵闹的表格文件说明,这些说明可以从诸如合成或嵌入式相似性等弱信号或弱监督技术中获得(Ratner等,2016年),如(Yin等,2020年;Eltabakh等,2023年).

blocks.en: LOKI trains the encoder contrastively on triples ( T , D + , D − ) (T,D^{+},D^{-}) with two objectives: a global one that ranks D + D^{+} above D − D^{-} for table T T from the aggregated pair scores, and a local one that, drawing on multiple-instance learning ( Ilse et al., 2018 ; Miech et al., 2020 ) , separates a sampled row’s best-matching sentence in D + D^{+} from its best in D − D^{-} . Together they induce fine-grained associations from coarse supervision. Once trained, LOKI discovers row-text links and text-mediated join paths: for each document, it identifies coarsely related tables, considers pairs of them, and uses the overlapping supporting text spans of their row-text links to construct join paths. LOKI encodes and groups the resulting paths using density-based clustering, where each cluster represents a distinct relationship between a pair of tables. An LLM names each relationship based on the evidence sentences, and LOKI creates one table per cluster, populated with the join paths.

LOKI一旦经过培训,就会发现行-文本链接和由文本调解的连接路径:对于每个文档,它都会识别粗细相通的表格,考虑其中的对等,并使用其行-文本链接的重叠支持文本跨度来构建连接路径. LOKI 使用基于密度的集群来编码和分组所产生的路径,其中每个集群代表一对表格之间的不同关系. LLM根据证据句命名了每个关系,而LOKI每组创建一个表格,包含连接路径.

blocks.en: Contributions . This work makes the following contributions to multi-modal discovery and querying:
blocks.zh: 捐款 这项工作对多式联运的发现和查询作出了以下贡献:

blocks.en: • Novel problem. We introduce Discovery-Driven Integration, the setting in which relationships between tables mediated by text documents are unknown, and formalize its core task as Text-Mediated Join Path Discovery. To the best of our knowledge, no prior method jointly discovers, disambiguates, and materializes latent row-sentence-row relationships, into integrated tables. • Joint representation-learning architecture. We introduce the LOKI encoder, which learns contextualized row-text representations from coarse table-text supervision alone, enabling fine-grained associations to emerge without explicit row-sentence annotations. Unlike existing column-based approaches that use vertical attention within a table column ( Yin et al., 2020 ; Eltabakh et al., 2023 ) , LOKI uses horizontal bidirectional cross-attention between rows and sentences. • SOTA Performance. We evaluate LOKI on an end-to-end integration task using real-world datasets, bridging disjoint tables through fine-grained row-sentence-row evidence and materializing typed relations at a fraction of the LLM token cost. LOKI also outperforms existing cross-modal discovery and representation-learning methods at coarse-grained discovery.
blocks.zh: • 小说问题。 我们介绍“发现-驱动集成”,即文本文档调解的表格之间的关系未知的设置,并将其核心任务正式化为“文本-驱动集成路径发现”。 据我们所知,没有任何一种方法可以共同发现、混淆和形成潜在的排刑关系,从而形成综合表格。 • 联合代表-学习架构。 我们引入了LOKI编码器,它仅从粗糙的表格文本监督中学习背景化的行文字表述,使得精细的有纹饰的协会在没有明确的行刑说明的情况下出现. 与表列内使用垂直关注的现有列法不同(Yin等,2020;Eltabakh等,2023),LOKI在行和句子之间采用横向双向交叉关注. • SOTA性能。 我们利用现实世界的数据集对LOKI进行端到端的整合任务评价,通过精细的行刑层证据来连接脱节的表格,并以LLM符号成本的一小部分实现打字关系. LOKI在粗糙的发现中也超过了现有的跨模式发现和表现学习方法。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: We situate LOKI at the intersection of multi-modal data discovery and integration: existing discovery systems retrieve related tables or table-document pairs, while integration systems operate over predefined links, schemas, or queries. LOKI bridges the two through discovery-driven integration , using text to discover and materialize relationships between disjoint tables.
blocks.zh: 我们把LOKI置于多模式数据发现和集成的交叉点:现有发现系统检索相关的表格或表格文件对,而集成系统则运行在预先定义的链接、计划或查询上。 LOKI通过发现驱动的整合将两者相通,使用文本来发现并实现脱节表之间的关系.

blocks.en: Join-Path Discovery. Our definition of Text-Mediated Join Path introduces a row-to-row association mediated by natural language sentences, whereas prior work defined join paths primarily at the table or schema level. In systems such as Metam ( Galhotra et al., 2023 ) , Data Civilizer ( Mansour et al., 2018 ) , Aurum ( Fernandez et al., 2018a ) , and SemDisc ( Mohammad and Rezig, 2026 ) , join paths denote ordered chains of joinable datasets used for data discovery or augmentation, but these remain purely structural, without textual mediation or record-level grounding. Ver ( Gong et al., 2023 ; Dharmawan et al., 2024 ) extends this notion to schema-agnostic view discovery with no predefined foreign keys. The novelty of our formulated join path lies in its formulation as an explicit fine-grained transitive bridge through mediating sentences as evidence of latent relationships. This also differs from multi-modal discovery systems that stop at one-hop table-document retrieval ( Eltabakh et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 加入-Path发现. 我们对"文本调用连接路径"的定义引入了以自然语言句子为介导的行到行关联,而之前的工作定义主要在表格或计划级别上连接路径. 在Metam等系统中(Galhotra等,2023年),数据文明者 (Mansour等, 2018年), Aurum (Fernandez等, 2018a),和SemDisc (Mohammad and Rezig, 2026年) 相接路径表示所订购的用于数据发现或增强的可合并数据集链,但这些数据集仍然是纯结构的,没有文本调解或记录级的地基. Ver (Gong等, 2023; Dharmawan等, 2024)将这个概念延伸至没有预先定义的外国密钥的有计划-不可知论视图发现. 我们拟订的加入道路的新颖之处在于,它是一个明确的精细过渡桥梁,通过调解句子证明潜在的关系。 这与多模式发现系统也不同,后者止于一跳式表格文件检索(Eltabakh等,2023年)。

blocks.en: Semantic Table Discovery. Current research moves beyond syntactic value overlaps to capture semantic relatedness between tables. DeepJoin ( Dong et al., 2023 ) and Snoopy ( Guo et al., 2025 ) fine-tune Transformer-based models to encode column values, identifying joinable columns based on semantic proximity rather than exact matches. FREYJA ( Maynou et al., 2024 ) combines data profiling with predictive modeling to approximate semantics-aware joins, while OmniMatch ( Koutras et al., 2025 ) constructs a graph of columns to propagate similarity signals. SANTOS ( Khatiwada et al., 2023 ) retrieves unionable tables using semantic relationships between column pairs from an external or synthesized knowledge base, while KGLiDS ( Helali et al., 2024 ) captures dataset semantics with learned data profiles and knowledge graphs. Despite their different mechanisms, these approaches derive their discovery signals from table values, profiles, metadata, or semantics constructed from tabular artifacts, and cannot discover relationships between disjoint tables when the connecting evidence exists only in external text, which LOKI instead exploits as a semantic bridge to discover row-level relationships.
blocks.zh: 语义表出所出. 目前的研究超越了综合值相重叠的范畴来捕捉表格之间的语义关联. DeepJoin (Dong等, 2023)和Snoopy (Guo等, 2025) 微调变形器基模型来编码列值,根据语义相近而非精确相匹配确定可相接列. FREYJA (Maynou等,2024年) 将数据剖析与预测模型结合到近似语义-知觉上,而OmniMatch (Koutras等,2025年) 则构建出一列图来传播类似信号. SANTOS(Khatiwada等,2023年)利用从外部或合成的知识库中取出一列对子之间的语义关系来取出可结合的表;而KGLiDS(Helali等,2024年)则以所学的数据剖面和知识图来取取出数据集语义. 尽管其机制不同,这些方法还是从表格文物构建的表值,剖面图,元数据,或语义学中获取出发现信号,当连接证据只存在于外文本时,无法发现脱节表之间的关系,而LOKI则利用这种关系作为语义桥来发现行级关系.

blocks.en: Joint Representation Learning. To bridge the gap between tables and text, prior work learns a unified embedding space. SEMPROP ( Fernandez et al., 2018b ) and Termite ( Fernandez and Madden, 2019 ) project structured and unstructured data into a shared latent space to retrieve related items based on vector proximity. TABERT ( Yin et al., 2020 ) and PNEUMA ( Balaka et al., 2025 ) linearize tables to learn joint representation with text, often for Question Answering (QA) or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) tasks. These approaches operate at a coarse schema or document granularity: they function as semantic search engines rather than integration systems and do not extract explicit, row-level join paths, whereas LOKI resolves fine-grained row-sentence associations, transforming black-box retrieval scores into interpretable, transitive join paths.
blocks.zh: 联合代表学习。 为了弥合表格和文本之间的差距,前作学习了统一的嵌入空间. SEMPROP(Fernandez等,2018年b)和Termite(Fernandez和Madden,2019年)项目将数据结构化和无结构化,形成一个共享的潜入空间,以根据向量相近取回相关物品. TABERT (Yin等,2020年)和PNEUMA (Balaka等,2025年)将表格线性化,以学习与文本的联合表述,经常用于问答(QA)或检索-增强生成(RAG)任务. 这些方法在粗糙的图案或文档颗粒性中运作:它们作为语义搜索引擎而非集成系统发挥作用,不取出清晰的行级接合路径,而LOKI则解决了细纹接合接合,将黑盒取回分数转化为可解释的,可过渡接合路径.

blocks.en: Multi-Modal Data Discovery. Several systems retrieve related data across structured and unstructured data. OTTER ( Huang et al., 2022 ) jointly retrieves tables and text, but its retrieval unit is a table row pre-linked to text passages via entity linking, relying on existing links rather than discovering them. CMDL ( Eltabakh et al., 2023 ) and Tri-Encoder ( Kostić et al., 2021 ) support data-lake queries over structured and unstructured data, returning ranked table- or column-document associations. TabSTAR ( Arazi et al., 2025 ) jointly represents structured attributes and text fields for tabular prediction, also supporting cross-modal retrieval. These systems narrow the candidate sources, but their coarse-grained outputs do not determine which rows connect, which sentences support the connection, or which relationships they express; using them directly for integration may produce spurious joins, e.g., linking a patient to every medication in the same summary. LOKI instead composes fine-grained row-sentence associations into evidence-backed row-sentence-row paths for relation-specific integration.
blocks.zh: 多模数据发现. 一些系统通过结构化和非结构化的数据检索相关数据。 OTTER(Huang等,2022年)联合取回了表格和文本,但其取回单位是通过实体链接与文本段落预先链接的表格行,依靠已有链接而不是发现. CMDL(Eltabakh等,2023年)和Tri-Encoder(Kostić等,2021年)在结构化和无结构化的数据上支持数据-湖泊查询,返回排名表或列文件协会. TabSTAR(Arazi等人,2025年)联合代表了结构化属性和表格预测的文本字段,也支持跨模式检索. 这些系统缩小了候选来源,但是其粗糙的纹理输出不能确定哪个行连接,哪个句子支持连接,或者它们表达的是什么关系;直接使用它们进行整合可能会产生虚假的结合,例如将病人与同一份摘要中的每一种药物联系起来. LOKI反而将精细的行刑协会编为证据支持的行刑-行刑-行刑路径,用于特定关系整合.

blocks.en: Schema/Query-Driven Integration. Existing multi-modal integration systems assume a predefined relational structure. THOR ( Rahman et al., 2024 ) populates values for a target concept from related text. ELEET ( Urban and Binnig, 2024 ) extracts registered attributes into latent tables and composes them with relational operators. Its multi-modal join assumes table tuples are already linked to documents. ThalamusDB ( Jo and Trummer, 2024 ) evaluates explicit natural-language predicates within SQL queries over a known multi-modal schema, whereas iDataLake ( Wang et al., 2025 ) uses an analytical query to select sources and construct an execution plan. ConnectionLens ( Anadiotis et al., 2022 ) integrates heterogeneous sources by extracting and linking entities from text and other sources. These systems operate once the required links, schemas, or queries are supplied, but do not determine which cross-table relations should exist when both connections and relationship types are unknown. LOKI , in contrast, discovers row-sentence-row paths, disambiguates their semantics, and materializes them as evidence-backed tables without a predefined schema.
blocks.zh: Schema/Query-Driven 集成。 现有的多式一体化系统假定预先确定的关系结构。 THOR(Rahman等,2024年)从相关文本中填入目标概念的值. ELET (Urban and Binnig, 2024) 将已注册属性提取到潜伏的表格中并用关系操作符来作曲. 它的多模式结合假设表图已经与文件相连接。 ThalamusDB(Jo and Trummer, 2024)在SQL查询中评价一个已知的多模式计划中明确的自然语言上游,而iDataLake(Wang等人,2025年)则使用分析查询来选择来源并构建执行计划. ConnectLens(Anadiotis等,2022年)通过从文本和其他来源取出和连接实体,整合了各种来源。 这些系统在提供所需的链接,计划,或查询后即会运行,但在连接和关系类型都未知的情况下,无法确定哪些交叉表关系应当存在. 相比之下,LOKI发现行-判决-排行路径,使其语义脱节,并实现作为证据支持的表格,没有预先定义的策略.

blocks.en: 3.2. Contextualized Embeddings
blocks.zh: 3.2. 内嵌背景

blocks.en: The distinguishing characteristic of the LOKI encoder is its bidirectional cross-attention module. Unlike traditional unidirectional attention, it is designed around the premise that cross-modal association requires a symmetric exchange of information: a table row’s meaning is grounded by the sentences that mention its entities, and a sentence’s relevance is determined by the referenced tabular data. This stage produces contextualized cross-modal representations .

blocks.en: We empirically evaluate LOKI through three experiments that examine successive stages of the same discovery-driven integration pipeline: (i) architectural evaluation of representation learning for implicit association, (ii) multi-modal data discovery, and (iii) data integration. blocks.en: No publicly available benchmark natively provides the typed row-sentence-row annotations required by our Text-Mediated Join Path Discovery task; existing benchmarks target generation, question answering, or coarse discovery instead. We therefore constructed ground truth over four complementary datasets, summarized in Table 2 and used throughout the three experiments; all of them are publicly released. 3 3 3 Datasets: https://github.com/dtim-upc/LOKI/tree/main/Datasets FEVEROUS ( Aly et al., 2021 ) is an open-domain Wikipedia fact-verification benchmark whose evidence combines table cells with sentences, from which we derive row-sentence associations. We manually annotated ProTrix ( Wu and Feng, 2024 ) using the original question-answer pairs. blocks.en: 5.2. Experiment 1: Architectural Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.2. 实验1:建筑评估

blocks.en: The first experiment investigates whether a model trained exclusively using coarse table-text associations can simultaneously learn: (i) global table-text relevance, required for multi-modal discovery, and (ii) fine-grained row-sentence associations, required for join path extraction. This setting presents a fundamental supervision dilemma. Coarse table-document associations are comparatively easy to obtain, whereas explicitly annotating every supporting row-sentence pair is expensive and domain-dependent, and such annotations are scarce. Standard sentence encoders represent rows and sentences independently and provide no mechanism for identifying which local interactions explain the relevance of an entire table-document pair. LOKI instead derives the global score from a pair-score matrix over mutually contextualized representations, so we can ask whether local association emerges from the global objective alone.
blocks.zh: 第一项实验研究了专门使用粗表文字协会培训的模型是否可以同时学习:(一) 多式联运发现所需的全球表格文字相关性;(二) 加入路径提取所需的精细的行刑协会。 这种环境构成了一种根本的监督困境。 粗糙的表格文件协会比较容易获得,而明确注明每对支持性行刑的一对是昂贵的和依赖域的,这种说明很少。 标准句子编码器独立地代表行和句子,没有为识别哪个局部交互解释整个表格文档对的相关性提供机制. 反之,LOKI从一个双分数矩阵中得出全球得分,而不是相互关联的表述,因此我们可以问,地方协会是否仅来自全球目标。

blocks.en: Investigated Architectures. We compare five configurations. The Baseline uses the Frozen Encoder ξ \xi alone to independently embed linearized rows and document sentences, scoring each row-sentence pair by cosine similarity without task-specific training or cross-attention. FT-Encoder fine-tunes ξ \xi using the global table-text triplet objective. Uni (R → \rightarrow S) contextualizes rows with sentences, whereas Uni (S → \rightarrow R) contextualizes sentences with table rows, while keeping ξ \xi frozen. LOKI uses the complete bidirectional architecture to jointly contextualize both modalities before constructing the pair-score matrix and aggregated global score (Fig. 2 ).

Table 3 shows that LOKI’s architecture generalizes across benchmarks and transfers across granularities, attaining the best local AP on every dataset and demonstrating that coarse supervision can induce stronger local association. The smaller local gain on Pharma reflects its silver annotations, derived from TF-IDF and keyword matching, which favor explicit lexical matches already captured by the Baseline and provide limited scope for measuring deeper semantic association. Overall, bidirectional contextualization transfers table-text supervision to row-sentence association more effectively than encoder fine-tuning or unidirectional attention; next we examine this capability in detail.

blocks.en: Summary. Exp. 1 shows that off-the-shelf encoder fine-tuning and unidirectional attention do not reliably transfer coarse table-text supervision to fine-grained row-sentence association. LOKI finds better associations in both granularities without local supervision, while remaining more efficient than full encoder fine-tuning.

blocks.en: 5.3. Experiment 2: Multi-Modal Data Discovery
blocks.zh: 5.3. 实验2:多峰 数据发现

blocks.en: The second experiment evaluates whether LOKI’s global table-text score, derived from fine-grained row-sentence associations, supports accurate and scalable multi-modal data discovery. First , we evaluate whether LOKI learns both retrieval directions: unlike existing systems that are typically designed for a fixed query direction, LOKI learns a shared bidirectional representation, and we test whether a single trained instance can serve both document-to-table and table-to-document retrieval without retraining. Second , we compare it against state-of-the-art systems operating at the coarser table-document level and examine whether its bottom-up aggregation remains effective as the candidate pool grows.
blocks.zh: 第二个实验评价了LOKI的全球表文得分,这些得分来自精细的行刑协会,是否支持准确而可扩展的多式数据发现. 首先,我们评价LOKI是否学习了两个检索方向:与通常为固定查询方向而设计的现有系统不同,LOKI学习了共享的双向表示,我们测试一个经过训练的单个实例是否能够在不进行再培训的情况下既服务于文档到表格的检索,也服务于表格到文档的检索. 第二,我们将它与在较近的表格一级运行的最先进的系统进行比较,并审查它的自下而上汇总是否随着候选人才库的增长而有效。

blocks.en: Compared Systems. No existing system targets our fine-grained row-sentence discovery task, but several state-of-the-art approaches operate at the coarser table-document level. We therefore evaluate whether LOKI identifies the same information as these systems on their own coarse-grained task, while additionally providing the row-sentence traceability that enables the integration task of Exp. 3. We compare against three representative systems. CMDL ( Eltabakh et al., 2023 ) targets cross-modal data discovery and was primarily evaluated on the Pharma benchmark for document-to-table retrieval, motivating our use of the same dataset. TaBERT ( Yin et al., 2020 ) represents joint table-text representation learning, while TabSTAR ( Arazi et al., 2025 ) represents recent text-aware tabular foundation models.
blocks.zh: 比较系统. 现有系统没有针对我们精细的行刑发现任务,但几种最先进的方法在相近的表格一级运作。 因此,我们评价LOKI是否就其本身的粗糙工作确定与这些系统相同的信息,同时提供行刑追踪,使Exp能够完成综合任务。 3. 我们比较了三个具有代表性的系统。 CMDL(Eltabakh等人,2023年)的目标是发现跨模式数据,并主要根据Pharma基准对文件到表格检索进行评估,促使我们使用同一数据集。 TaBERT(Yin等,2020年)代表联合表-文本表达学习,而TabSTAR(Arazi等,2025年)代表近期的文本意识表格式基础模型.

blocks.en: Pharma Benchmark Construction. To ensure a fair comparison with CMDL ( Eltabakh et al., 2023 ) , we reconstruct Pharma from its 926 926 PubMed abstracts and 82 82 DrugBank tables. In the original dataset, 8 8 tables, spanning 15 15 ground-truth columns, are positively associated with every document, while the remaining 74 74 tables form the negative pool. We horizontally partition the source tables into row-disjoint candidate tables, ensuring that training, validation, and test splits do not reuse the same rows. For each query, the associated tables form the positive candidates and are paired with an equal number of randomly sampled negative candidates. We additionally inject non-matching rows into positive candidates to prevent models from relying only on isolated lexical matches. The test split contains 140 140 query documents and 2,240 2{,}240 candidate tables in the Full retrieval pool. This construction requires models to infer query-specific table relevance rather than memorize stable table or column associations.
blocks.zh: 制药基准建设. 为确保与CMDL(Eltabakh等,2023年)进行公平比较,我们从Pharma的926 926 PubMed摘要和82个DrugBank表格中重建了Pharma。 在原始数据集中,8 8个表,跨越15个地面真相栏,与每个文件都有正面联系,而其余74个表构成负数。 我们横向地将源表分割为行-行-相离的候选表,确保训练,验证,测试分解不会重复使用同行. 对于每个查询,相联的表格构成正候选人,与随机抽样的正候选人数量相等. 我们还将非匹配行注入正候选人,以防止模型只依赖孤立的词汇匹配. 测试分页包含140个140个查询文档和2,240个2{,}240个候选表格在全检索池中. 这种构造需要模型推断出特定查询表的相关性,而不是记住稳定的表或列关联.

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocol. Following the objective, we first evaluate whether LOKI learns both directions: we report cross-dataset Mean Average Precision ( MAP ) on Pharma and MIMIC-IV for document-to-table and table-to-document retrieval, and then evaluate cross-direction generalization on Pharma. The architecture is direction-agnostic; only the training triplets are anchored on one modality. We call a configuration direction-matched when the training anchor and the retrieval query use the same modality, and direction-mismatched otherwise; the latter tests whether a single trained instance can serve either query modality without retraining. These comparisons use a fixed pool of 50 candidates per query to control retrieval difficulty. Second, following CMDL ’s native document-to-table setting, we progressively increase the candidate-table pool and report F1@ K K , NDCG@ K K , mean reciprocal rank (MRR@ K K ), MAP, mean rank, and inference time to assess retrieval quality and scalability under realistic data-lake conditions.
blocks.zh: 评价协议。 按照目标,我们首先评估LOKI是否学习了两个方向:我们报告关于Pharma和MIMIC-IV的跨数据集平均精度(MAP),用于文档对表格和表格对文档的检索,然后评价关于Pharma的交叉方向概括。 这一架构具有方向不可知性;只有培训三胞胎以一种模式为基础。 当训练主播和检索查询使用相同的模式时,我们称之为配置方向比对,而方向比对则不然;后者测试一个经过训练的单一实例是否能够在不进行再培训的情况下服务于任何一种查询模式。 这些比较使用每个查询50名候选人的固定库来控制检索困难。 第二,根据CMDL的本土文档到表格设置,我们逐渐增加候选表格集合,并报告F1@KK,NDCG@KK,表示对等等级(MRR@KK),MAP,平均等级,以及在现实的数据湖条件下评估检索质量和可扩展性的推断时间.

blocks.en: Cross-dataset Bidirectional Discovery. On both datasets, LOKI supports both retrieval directions without retraining (Table 4 ), with direction-dependent behavior reflecting the distinct discovery workflows of each benchmark. On MIMIC-IV, it reaches 0.42 MAP for document-to-table and 0.54 for table-to-document retrieval, whereas the latter is noticeably weaker on Pharma. This follows from Pharma’s construction: every document is associated with the same eight source tables, so a table query faces a large, diffuse set of relevant abstracts with limited discriminative signal. Existing systems are typically specialized for one query direction and require separate training or retrieval pipelines for the reverse task. LOKI instead provides a single representation that supports both query modalities without retraining.

blocks.en: Scalability Analysis. Fig. 8 evaluates document-to-table retrieval as the candidate-table pool increases from 50 50 to the Full set of 2,240 2{,}240 candidates. We report metrics at K = 8 K=8 because each Pharma query document is associated with eight relevant tables. LOKI consistently achieves the strongest retrieval quality across all pool sizes and degrades less drastically than the competing systems. At the Full scale it roughly triples the F1@8 and MAP of the second-strongest TaBERT, achieves the lowest mean rank by placing relevant tables approximately 56% earlier, and completes full-pool retrieval 32 × 32\times faster than TaBERT. Although CMDL is faster still due to its ANN-based approximate retrieval, its retrieval quality collapses at scale, with MAP approximately 35 × 35\times lower than LOKI’s.

blocks.en: Summary. Exp. 2 demonstrates that LOKI’s fine-grained row-sentence associations provide a strong basis for multi-modal discovery: a single trained instance serves either retrieval direction without retraining, and remains the strongest method as the candidate pool grows.
blocks.zh: 摘要. 第2出处表明,LOKI的精益求精的行刑协会为多种模式的发现提供了坚实基础:一个经过培训的单一案例要么提供检索方向,要么不进行再培训,随着候选人才队伍的增长,它仍然是最有力的方法。

blocks.en: 5.4. Experiment 3: Data Integration
blocks.zh: 5.4. 实验3:数据整合

blocks.en: The third experiment evaluates whether fine-grained row-sentence associations underlying table-document discovery can be transformed into explicit text-mediated join paths and subsequently materialized as relationship-specific Typed Tables , completing the progression from association to discovery and finally integration .
blocks.zh: 第三个实验评价了表文件发现背后的细纹行刑协会是否可以转变为明确的由文字调解的结合路径,然后作为关系特定类型表实现,完成从关联到发现的进取,最后实现融合.

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocol. We evaluate end-to-end integration on 382 MIMIC-IV admissions, each constituting an independent integration problem over the schematically disjoint Diagnosis and Medications tables and their associated Clinical Notes . For each admission, LOKI transforms the discovered text-mediated join paths into provenance-preserving Typed Tables. Since the Generalization Function G G produces open-world relationship names, we ground them to the canonical relation types ℛ \mathcal{R} before comparing the predicted Typed Tables with their ground-truth counterparts.
blocks.zh: 评价协议。 我们评价382个MIMIC-IV入院病例的端到端整合情况,每个入院病例都构成一个独立的整合问题,与图解不相连的诊断和药物表及其相关的临床说明相比。 对于每次录入,LOKI都会将所发现的由文字介导的连接路径转换为出处保留键入表. 由于通用函数 G G 生成了开放- 世界关系名称, 在将预测的打字表与地面对等物进行比较之前, 我们先将其定位为 Cononical 关系类型 R\ mathcal{ R} 。

blocks.en: Compared Systems. We instantiate G G with two interchangeable open-weight local LLMs, GPT-OSS 20B and Qwen-3.6, denoted as LOKI (GPT-OSS) and LOKI (Qwen-3.6) , respectively. We compare LOKI against direct LLM-based integration using the same local Qwen-3.6 , and additionally include Qwen-3.7 as a stronger API-based frontier baseline. The direct LLMs receive the relevant Diagnosis table, Medications table, and Clinical Notes directly and infer typed row-pair relationships for materialization as Typed Tables under the same canonical schema, thereby evaluating relation inference over known inputs rather than table-document discovery or text-mediated join-path recovery.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate the outputs at two complementary levels. At the typed-pair level , Best-Match Typed-Pair precision (P), recall (R), and F1 measure row-pair correctness and coverage after each predicted Typed Table is associated with its best-matching ground-truth relationship type. The reported summary scores are macro-averaged over admissions. At the Typed Table level , Type Acc. measures whether the predicted table is assigned the correct canonical relationship type, while Typed Table P, R, and F1 measure the final relationship-specific materialization quality and are likewise macro-averaged over admissions. For both levels we additionally report pooled counts and the corresponding micro scores, computed on the same evaluation surface as the macro metrics. For efficiency we report average runtime per admission, LLM token consumption, and estimated API-equivalent cost over the 382-admission test set.

blocks.en: RQ1: How accurately are relationship semantics disambiguated and materialized as Typed Tables?. Recovering a row pair alone is insufficient for semantic integration because the relationship expressed between the participating rows must also be distinguished. We therefore evaluate disambiguation through its final database-level consequence: whether the discovered relationships are assigned to the correct relationship-specific Typed Tables and whether their row-pair contents are faithfully materialized. blocks.en: Summary.. Exp. 3 shows that LOKI transforms discovered row-sentence associations into text-mediated join paths, disambiguates their relationships, and materializes them as provenance-preserving Typed Tables. Direct LLMs achieve stronger final materialization, primarily through higher coverage, whereas LOKI additionally performs the preceding discovery while requiring only about one third of the LLM token workload. By restricting LLM reasoning to compact evidence-backed relationship descriptions, the replaceable function G G can be selected according to latency, cost, and deployment requirements.
blocks.zh: 摘要. 第3行显示,LOKI将发现的行刑协会转变为以文字为媒介的结合路径,使其关系分化,并把它们变成保留出处的打字台。 直接有限责任公司主要通过提高覆盖面,实现更强有力的最终实现,而LOKI则额外完成先前的发现,同时只需要大约三分之一的有限责任公司的工作量。 通过将LLM推理限制在紧凑的由证据支撑的关系描述中,可替换功能GG可以根据耐久性,成本和部署需要来选择.

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结论

blocks.en: This paper studies the discovery of latent relational structure between disjoint tables and unstructured text, uncovering not only which sources are relevant but how they are connected. We formalized Text-Mediated Join Path Discovery as the task of identifying and organizing row-sentence associations into coherent relational structures, and introduced LOKI , a horizontal bidirectional cross-attention model that, from coarse-grained supervision alone, induces fine-grained row-sentence associations, composes them into join paths, and organizes these into relation-consistent groups supporting provenance-aware integration.
blocks.zh: 本文研究了在不相连的表格和无结构文本之间发现的潜在关系结构,不仅揭示了哪些来源是相关的,而且揭示了它们是如何相互联系的。 我们正式将 " 文字调解 " 加入 " 发现 " 作为确定和组织行刑协会的任务,使之成为连贯的关系结构,并引入了 " LOKI " 这一横向双向交叉关注模式,从粗糙的监管中引出精细的行刑协会,将其编成 " 加入 " 道路 " ,并将它们组织成符合关系的群体,支持 " 来源意识 " 的融合。

blocks.en: Candidate discovery currently requires scoring all table-document pairs, with a cost proportional to | 𝒯 | ​ | 𝒟 | |\mathcal{T}||\mathcal{D}| ; although these evaluations can be batched, an indexable task-specific retrieval representation remains an important direction for scaling to substantially larger data lakes. A second limitation is coverage: LOKI recovers typed row pairs with high precision but lower recall compared to direct LLM prompting, so improving recall of the underlying row-sentence associations is the clearest path to stronger end-to-end integration. A third limitation concerns relationship labeling: as a joint table-text representation model, LOKI delegates canonical relationship naming to the Generalization Function G G . This concerns only downstream ontology-specific labeling, not the discovery of the underlying relational structure; future work aims to improve G G via ontology-aware calibration and learnable naming.
blocks.zh: 候选人发现目前需要给所有表格文件对打分,成本比例为QQ T QQ D QQMathcal{TQMathcal{D}|;虽然这些评价可以分批进行,但可索引的针对特定任务的检索表示仍然是向大得多的数据湖进行分级的重要方向. 第二个限制是覆盖:LOKI以高精度但较直接的LLM提示更低的回想方式回收打入的行配对,因此,改善回想基础的行刑协会是更强大的端到端融合的最清晰的途径. 第三个限制涉及关系标签:LOKI代表作为联合表格文本代表模式,对通用函数GG进行命名。 这只涉及下游肿瘤特有标签,而不涉及潜在关系结构的发现;未来的工作旨在通过肿瘤认知校正和可学取名来改进G G.

blocks.en: Our evaluation across four complementary datasets demonstrates this progression from representation learning to multi-modal discovery and, ultimately, integration, at roughly one third of the LLM token cost of competing approaches. More broadly, unstructured text can serve as explicit relational evidence that makes disconnected data interpretable, auditable, and queryable.
blocks.zh: 我们对四个补充数据集的评价表明,从代表性学习到多模式发现,以及最终的一体化,其成本大约是相互竞争的方法的LLM象征性成本的三分之一。 更广泛地说,非结构化文本可以作为明确的关系证据,使断开的数据可以解释、审计和查询。
